parameters.name: gatewayType
parameters.description: The gateway type to filter. Valid values: **AI** and **API**.

parameters.name: nameLike
parameters.description: The domain name keyword for fuzzy search.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: resourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun apig list-domains --name-like test --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --gateway-id gw-xxxxxx --domain-scope Serverless --resource-group-id rg-aek27lpqyiie6qy --gateway-type API --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun apig GET /v1/domains --region cn-hangzhou --nameLike test --pageNumber 1 --gatewayType API --domainScope Serverless --pageSize 10 --resourceGroupId 'rg-aek27lpqyiie6qy' --gatewayId 'gw-xxxxxx' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
